contract.direct_answer: Based on general zebrafish pronephros biology, the canonical segment-specific markers are: proximal tubule (proximal convoluted/straight) — slc20a1a and trpm7/slc13a1 with the classic proximal marker being slc20a1a; distal early (DE) — slc12a1 (the NKCC2 co-transporter); distal late (DL) — slc12a3 (the NCC co-transporter); and the pronephric duct — gata3 (and stc300/clcnk in the collecting-duct region). However, I CANNOT provide verified ENSDARG identifiers for any of these markers from the supplied evidence bundle. I therefore decline to assert any gene ID, because doing so would require recalling identifiers from memory, which is prohibited.
